description: ESR-thermal model: P_loss = ESR(T)*I_cap^2 + dielectric_loss_factor*Q_comp; ESR(T) follows Arrhenius correction; reactive power derated above rated temperature per IEC 60831-1.

unit.name: Generic 11 kV Shunt Capacitor Bank, 1 MVAR
unit.source: IEEE Std 1036-2010: Guide for Shunt Capacitors; IEC 60831-1:2014; Tan, X. et al. (2016) capacitor bank losses; ABB Power Capacitors product data.

C_uF.note: Equivalent bank capacitance at 50 Hz: C = Q/(2*pi*f*V^2) = 1e6/(2*pi*50*11e3^2)

ESR_ref_ohm.note: Equivalent Series Resistance at T_ref=25 C (polypropylene film, ~0.005 Ohm per unit)

ESR_alpha.note: ESR temperature coefficient (negative: PP film ESR decreases slightly with T, typical -0.3%/K below 70C)

tan_delta_ref.note: Dissipation factor at T_ref (0.02% = 0.0002 typical for PP film capacitors per IEC 60831-1)

tan_delta_alpha.note: Increase in tan_delta per K above T_ref

T_max_C.note: IEC 60831-1 max operating temperature for PP film

derating_slope.note: Q output derating above T_max: ~1.5%/K above T_max
